title: Informed consent: whose job is it

cover.title: Consent: is it your job to get it?
cover.kicker: The nurse witnesses consent. The nurse does not obtain it.

lines.say: Consent. Is it your job to get it?
No. The nurse witnesses consent. The nurse doesn't obtain it.
Valid consent needs capacity, a free choice, enough information, and it has to match the procedure.
The person doing the procedure gets the consent. Your job is to check the patient understands, and the form is complete.
And consent can be withdrawn at any time. Even after the form is signed.
In Australia, each state and territory has its own consent and guardianship laws, so check the rules where you work.
